result.headline: Outputs ch[3] and ch[4] froze at 1500 us at t=116.327 s while ch[5] and the setpoints kept moving.
result.explanation: A control fault occurred: two actuator output channels stopped following and held neutral from 116.327 s to the end. The recording does not show who or what commanded the hold, or whether the fault is in the output stage, the mixer or the actuator.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[3]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=116.327 s to the end of the recording (27.135 s, 84 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[3] froze at 1500 us from 116.327 s to the end, with no event or mode change.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[4]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=116.327 s to the end of the recording (27.135 s, 84 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[4] froze at the same instant as ch[3]. ch[5] kept varying (1284 to 1683 us), so this is not a global output loss.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=130.546 s: vehicle.attitude[roll] followed control.attitude_setpoint[roll] worse for good (typical |error| 1.888 -> 7.885)
evidence.shows: Roll tracking error roughly doubled after 130.546 s (ratio 2.01 in compare), later than the freeze. Probably a consequence, but unproven.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.587 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: A start-up sensor-health error. No later event or change points back to it, so it is not tied to the freeze.

checked.check: Events and sequence around the freeze
checked.result: The only two events are at 0.587 s (start-up). Nothing was logged at 116.327 s. In the sequence, roll, yaw and outputs left baseline from about 110.006 s, which looks like a manoeuvre. The freeze has no logged trigger.
ch[3] and ch[4] are flagged frozen (spread 10.0 and 21.0 us to 0.0). Roll and pitch tracking are unchanged just after (roll ratio 0.97, pitch 1.05). Yaw tracking improved (ratio 0.48).
checked.about: Output-stage freeze on ch[3] and ch[4]

checked.check: Roll setpoint against ch[3] and against ch[5] before the freeze
checked.result: Correlation is 0.266 for ch[3] and 0.267 for ch[5], and 0.583 and 0.584 at lag -1.314 s. This suggests roll-related channels, inferred only since no ROLE line names them.
Roll typical error went from 4.097 to 8.243 deg (ratio 2.01), yaw ratio 1.53. No output froze then, so likely an effect of the earlier freeze plus manoeuvre amplitude.
checked.about: Degraded roll tracking as an effect

checked.check: Window of ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], roll and yaw after the freeze
checked.result: ch[3] and ch[4] sit at 1500 from the sample at 116.754 onward. ch[5] swings between 1284 and 1683 us. Roll setpoint and attitude keep moving, so controller and estimator were still running.
No lessons exist for this signature.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=130.546 s: vehicle.attitude[roll] followed control.attitude_setpoint[roll] worse for good (typical |error| 1.888 -> 7.885)
effects.why: Probable consequence of losing two output channels; the delay after the freeze means the link is not proven.

hypotheses.claim: The roll tracking loss at 130.546 s is a consequence of losing ch[3] and ch[4].
